---
title: "Does the airframe with specified electronics achieve the claimed 156 g?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0
SOLVE_BUDGET = 10.0

breakdown_flat = mass_breakdown("flat")
breakdown_folded = mass_breakdown("folded")

m_dry_flat = breakdown_flat["dry_total_g"]
m_delta_flat = breakdown_flat["delta_g"]
m_foam_flat = breakdown_flat["foam_g"]
m_elec_flat = breakdown_flat["electronics_g"]

m_dry_folded = breakdown_folded["dry_total_g"]
m_diff_folded = m_dry_folded - m_dry_flat
m_claimed = 156.0
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{m_dry_flat:.1f} g"`]{.hero-value}
[calculated dry mass of flat-plate airframe]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** No. The airframe with specified electronics reaches [`{python} f"{m_dry_flat:.1f} g"`]{.key} dry, exceeding the claimed `{python} f"{m_claimed:.0f} g"` specification by [`{python} f"{m_delta_flat:.1f} g"`]{.key} (@tbl-mass). The bare Maker Foam airframe accounts for [`{python} f"{m_foam_flat:.1f} g"`]{.key} and the powertrain and avionics add [`{python} f"{m_elec_flat:.1f} g"`]{.key}. As a sensitivity, folding the wing skin per the Flite Test plan increases wing foam area, adding [`{python} f"{m_diff_folded:.1f} g"`]{.key} to reach [`{python} f"{m_dry_folded:.1f} g"`]{.key}, representing the dominant mass uncertainty.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-mass
#| tbl-cap: "Subsystem dry mass breakdown for flat-plate build."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

header = ["Subsystem", "Mass", "Share"]
rows = [
    (name, f"{grams:.1f} g", f"{100.0 * grams / m_dry_flat:.1f}%")
    for name, grams in (
        ("Foam airframe", breakdown_flat["foam_g"]),
        ("Electronics", breakdown_flat["electronics_g"]),
        ("Hardware", breakdown_flat["hardware_g"]),
        ("Hot glue", breakdown_flat["glue_g"]),
    )
]
rows.append(("Total dry mass", f"{m_dry_flat:.1f} g", "100.0%"))
md_table(header, rows)
```
